name: Valley of Tears
note: Panhandle caprock country — sand, red dirt, and the Quitaque Peaks, with sections through Caprock Canyons State Park and the Little Red River washes. Debuted 2024 and sold out at 600 riders. $26,000 prize purse, a Friday night gravel criterium, and a 2:15pm cutoff on the long course. Hosted the inaugural USA Cycling Collegiate Gravel National Championships and a stop on the Junior Gravel National Series.
